page.layout: Top: a printed table of contents of the Quaestiones, one line per entry, with the numbers at the left margin. A brace joins the six numbered questions, which sit under "Quartum". Below it, a rule and a centred heading "Septima Prælectionis Summarium." Below the heading, the summary text in two sections, with a large initial A. At the foot, the signature B, with a cut-off line beside it. Neighbouring page edge at the left and show-through excluded.

main_text.l: 8. ——Secundum. — aut possibilem quidem sed multum onerosam.
9. Tertium. — aut quæ fuit ante necessaria.
12. 1. An propter utilitatem publicam ferri debeat lex injusta?
15. 4. Cuinam Legi injustæ parere liceat, & cui non?
16. &c. 5. Quæ Justitia requiratur ad hoc, ut Lex aliqua sit obligatoria?

l.i: 6. Ubi subdito non constat de Lege, justane sit an injusta, quid faciendum?

main_text.l: 27. Quæ in adversam partem disputari solent, diluuntur.
main_text.head: Septima Prælectionis Summarium.
main_text.p: 2. &c. A Dubium Primum. Cujus sit Leges condere? Ubi statuitur Potestatem νομοθετικὴν[?] esse Potestatem Superioris,

page.notes: The large initial A is joined to "ntedictorum" as "Antedictorum". The Greek word "νομοθετικὴν" is doubtful and marked [?]. The final line is cut off at the edge of the scan. The page number, running head and catchword are not printed on this scan. Line-end numbers in the contents are page references kept with their lines. Show-through of the heading "Octavæ Prælectionis Summarium" and the neighbouring page edges are excluded.
